## About
Dwight's Moving Co. works out of Palmsprings Dr in Houston, moving individuals, families and commercial clients anywhere within the State of Texas. Our crew is long term personnel. We don't use day laborers.
We don't advertise, not even a yellow page ad. Our work comes from referrals and word of mouth, so every crew knows the next job depends on how this one goes. That's why you can depend on us to get the job done in an efficient time frame.
Customers rate us 4.5 from 39 reviews on Google. A reviewer called Dwight the owner fair and honest, and another wrote that James and Carl worked hard and were personable too.

## Services
- Moves Anywhere Within The State Of Texas: We move anywhere within the State of Texas.
- Residential Or Commercial Moves: Homes or businesses, we handle both.
- Large Moves Or Small Moves: No job is too big or too small.
- Full Packing Service: We can pack your entire home or office.
- Rental truck loading and unloading: Already rented a truck? We'll load it and unload it for you.

## FAQ
Q: How do you price a move?
A: Most moves are quoted on an hourly rate.

Q: Can I get a set price instead?
A: Yes. We can give a set price based on an accurate list of the work, usually for larger out of town moves.

Q: Where in Texas can you move me?
A: Anywhere within the State of Texas. We're licensed by TxDot to do it.

Q: Do I need to buy my own boxes and packing materials?
A: No. We can supply the packing materials, or we can use yours.

Q: What days can you move me?
A: We move seven days a week to fit your schedule.
